name: Think
summary: Think (@cloudflare/think) is the opinionated harness in Cloudflare's Agents SDK, introduced as Project Think in April 2026. A subclass supplies a model through getModel(), and Think runs the agentic loop, message persistence, streaming and stream resumption on a Durable Object. It adds tree-structured sessions with non-destructive compaction, context-block memory, Agent Skills, sub-agents and a workspace file system.
facts: Any, via getModel(); examples use Kimi on Workers AI
Workspace, sandboxed isolates, up to a full Cloudflare Sandbox
goodFor: Stateful chat agents on Cloudflare Workers
Long sessions that must survive restarts
watchOut: Runs only on Cloudflare's Durable Objects
